correctness.rationale: The facet-polar bijection and connected-tight-edge lemma bound all extreme integer potentials by the graph diameter two to normalized 3^10 words. Both all-ternary enumeration and the independent 3^9 spanning-tree-increment parameterization recover exactly the same 1410 potentials with no numerical tolerance. Exact formula K=10Σp_i²−(Σp_i)² gives the 11 rational squared-normal shells, the number of tight edges is exactly the facet vertex count (9–12), and a fully checked 18-orbit representative list under all S5 permutations and negation partitions the 1410 potentials. The second-support-distance gap is sqrt(10)/7−sqrt(5/28). Verification was replayed from the new package path.

value.rationale: For a distinguished 9-dimensional root polytope, the result completely classifies the combined metric distance, facet combinatorial size and natural symmetry type. It identifies 280 simplex facets, all eleven distance shells, eighteen distinct orbit classes and the precise 180-facet next shell beyond the known inball contacts. The relation of facet distance to facet shape is motivated by geometry and facet enumeration; this is a complete exact natural classification, not an arbitrarily selected statistic or merely a repeat of the known inradius.
